models_evaluated: 3D SegResNet (MONAI) DLAS bone segmentation hallucination screener

links.outcome: Automated detection of false bone/air hallucinations in AI-generated sCT images
links.effect: Screener specificity 0.78, 0.93, 0.98 at distance parameters 0.8, 1.0, 1.2 cm; flagged false high-density hallucinations in abdomen of sCT for all test patients.
links.quote: The average specificity of the DLAS model was 0.78, 0.93 and 0.98 for distance parameters of 0.8, 1.0 and 1.2 cm, respectively.

links.outcome: Presence of AI-generated hallucinations (false bone) in commercial sCT images
links.effect: Screener identified false high-density hallucination regions in the abdomen of AI-generated sCT images for all testing patients (n=10).
links.quote: The screener identified false high-density hallucination regions in the abdomen of AI-generated sCT images for all testing patients, highlighting potential issues with the training data used for the AI sCT model.

unlisted_practices: Independent deep-learning segmentation screener on MR to detect hallucinated bone in AI-generated synthetic CT for radiotherapy QA

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an automated quality assurance guardrail/screener to detect generative AI hallucinations in synthetic CT images within a clinical radiotherapy workflow.

primary.practice: automated hallucination detection and quality assurance screening
